mission.title: Pushing the limits of investment
mission.vision: Transforming the diaspora into a major economic lever for Africa by directing its financial flows toward productive investment.
points: Inform: Eliminate the information deficit to secure investments from expatriate executives.
Clarify: Structure a public-private dialogue (B2G) to make the tax framework clear.
Accompany: Ensure the local anchoring of projects in strategic sectors.

investir.title: How to invest — without picking the wrong door
investir.lead: Investing “back home” is not a wire transfer. It is a process: information, counterparts, anchoring, then a decision.
investir.disclaimer: DiaspoBoost is not a regulated financial intermediary. The platform accompanies, connects and organises. It does not sell securities, collect funds or promise any return.

steps.title: Clarify your intent

steps.title: Stay in the useful flow

gouvernance.title: Foundation and governance
gouvernance.founder: Founder of DiaspoBoost and of Business Congo Consulting, Stéphanie Kimbulu drives a pan-African vision: international summits, institutional partnerships and concrete bridges between Africa and its talent abroad.
gouvernance.org: A firm specialised in business engineering and investor accompaniment on the African continent. DiaspoBoost is powered by this structure — it is not a ministry.
gouvernance.net: During summits, the team works in coordination with local governments — including Patrick Muyaya, DRC Minister of Communication and Media, and representatives of the investment ministries of Morocco and Congo-Brazzaville. That coordination is not public ownership of the platform.

items.q: Is DiaspoBoost an app to buy stocks?
items.a: No. It is not a brokerage fintech. It is an exchange, summit and accompaniment platform to direct diaspora savings and expertise toward productive projects.

items.q: Do I pay online to book a service?
items.a: No. The form creates a request. The team contacts you. No payment is taken on this site.
Stéphanie Kimbulu, through Business Congo Consulting. The public institutions mentioned coordinate at summits; they are not owners of the site.

The Casablanca edition was held in April 2026 at Palace d’Anfa. Next: Colloquium on the Diaspora's Contribution to the National Economy in Kinshasa (22–23 October 2026), DiaspoBoost Investday in Antwerp (4 November 2026), then DiaspoBoost Summit Africa in Dakar (14–17 April 2027).

items.q: Can I submit a project from Africa?
items.a: Yes. Matchmaking is also for project holders and institutions, not only the diaspora.

items.q: How do I become a member?
items.a: Choose the adult or youth plan on the Members page, then send a request by form or WhatsApp. The team confirms membership. No payment is taken on this site.

items.q: How do I get the official reports?
items.a: Extracts and full PDFs are on the Reports page: read online, download, or open in a new tab.

items.q: How do I book project accompaniment?
items.a: Write to us on WhatsApp (the “Start my process” button or the Invest service). A pre-filled message opens: add your name and ask for a slot. The team replies in the same conversation.

items.q: How do I become a partner or sponsor?
items.a: Write via the form (partnership / sponsoring subject) or WhatsApp. The team will send a file tailored to your aims.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.body:
DiaspoBoost is an exchange platform hosted by Business Congo Consulting. Publisher: Stéphanie Kimbulu. Hosting and technical delivery: MOKILI (mokili.io).

Information on this site presents missions, summits and accompaniment services. It is neither investment advice nor a public offer of securities.

Contact: contact@diaspoboost.com · +243 812 226 604

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Purposes: handle service requests, contact messages, memberships and newsletter sign-up; improve the site.

Data: identity, email, phone where provided, country, profile, message, timestamps. No file selling.

Legal basis: consent (form checkboxes) and legitimate interest for site operation.

Retention: requests and messages kept 24 months; newsletter until you unsubscribe.

Your rights: access, correction, deletion — write to contact@diaspoboost.com.

No automated decision-making. Cookies are limited to operation (language, dismissing an alert in session).
